coreIdea: Inorder+(Preorder or Postorder)=always unique reconstruction. n0=n2+1 for 0-or-2-children trees. Max nodes at height h = 2^(h+1)-1.
mustRememberFormulas: Reconstruction needs Inorder + one of (Preorder/Postorder) — Pre+Post alone is NOT sufficient in general
n0=n2+1 (leaves = 2-degree nodes + 1) for 0-or-2-children trees; general: n=n0+n1+n2, n-1=n1+2n2
Max nodes height h (edges) = 2^(h+1)-1; Min = h+1
Distinct tree shapes with n nodes = Catalan number C(n)

commonTrapsQuickList: Preorder+Postorder alone does NOT uniquely reconstruct a general binary tree
Height = edges vs nodes — always confirm the definition first, off-by-one everywhere otherwise
n0=n2+1 only applies when every node has 0 or 2 children
1-indexed vs 0-indexed array formulas differ — check which the question uses
highYieldPyqLessons: Traversal reconstruction (14/53) and node-counting (12/53) together are ~49% of this topic — master these two first for maximum ROI.
